qc.label_under_test: Event nouns after ordinal or recurrence modifiers, especially numbered visits and readings.

neighbours.label: Event nouns after ordinal or recurrence modifiers, especially numbered visits and readings.
fire: On my third visit to Kyoto, I finally found the quiet temple behind the market.
The bill passed its second reading in parliament late on Tuesday night.
By her fifth visit, the nurses at the clinic knew her by name.
It was only on a repeated reading of the poem that I noticed the hidden rhyme.
The committee scheduled a first reading of the proposal for next month.
During his annual visit to the farm, Grandpa always checked the old well.
Each subsequent viewing of the film revealed another small detail in the background.
Her second attempt at the exam went much better than the first.
quiet: On my trip, I finally found the quiet temple behind the market in Kyoto.
The bill passed in parliament late on Tuesday night after long debate.
By then, the nurses at the clinic knew her by name.
It was only when I looked closely at the poem that I noticed the hidden rhyme.
The committee placed the proposal on the agenda for next month.
Grandpa always checked the old well whenever he was at the farm.
The film had another small detail hidden in the background.
Her exam went much better than she had expected.
